Only one interface governs markdown processing: `markdown.Service`. Its concrete implementation is the unexported package `service`.

The runtime instance is created in `NewAPIV1Service` and held by `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`. `RSSService` receives it via `NewRSSService` and passes it to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`. `memopayload.Runner` holds the field but is never instantiated in production; only tests call `NewRunner`.

At runtime, the concrete implementation is an unexported `service` struct returned by `markdown.NewService`.

It is constructed once in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`). The primary holder is `APIV1Service`, which passes it to `memo_service`, `memo_mention_helpers`, `memo_service_webhooks`, and `RebuildMemoPayload`. `RSSService.MarkdownService` also holds the same instance, receiving it from `server.go`. `memopayload.Runner` is not instantiated at runtime; only `RebuildMemoPayload` receives the service as a parameter.

Internally, the `service` struct uses goldmark and creates `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` on demand. Test construction via `test_helper.go` is excluded from runtime. A frontend markdown interface was considered but not found.

The backend uses a clear interface pattern centered on `markdown.Service`.

The frontend consumes react-markdown directly without a similar abstraction. The concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, backed by goldmark. It is constructed inside `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `markdown.NewService` with tag and mention extensions.

`APIV1Service` and `RSSService` both hold `markdown.Service` as a field. `RSSService` receives the same instance from `server/server.go`. `memopayload.Runner` declares the field type but is never instantiated at runtime; only `RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the interface as a function parameter.

Production runtime uses a single instance created by NewAPIV1Service. It is wired in server.go to RSS.

The concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. It is constructed by `NewAPIV1Service` and held by `server.go`. `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` is a concrete struct but is not behind an interface; it is instantiated directly within service methods.

h13.

**impl — construction — holders**

- **impl:** The unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` is the sole concrete type implementing `markdown.Service`; it wraps a goldmark parser/renderer configured with GFM plus optional tag/mention extensions.
- **construction:** At runtime it is created once by `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` inside `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (called from `server/server.go`).
- **holders:** The live instance is stored on `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`) and passed into `RSSService.MarkdownService` via `rss.NewRSSService(..., apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` in `server/server.go` / `server/router/rss/rss.go`. Other call sites (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `memo_mention_helpers.go`, `memo_service_webhooks.go`, and `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) take the interface as a parameter from `APIV1Service` rather than holding their own copy. `memopayload.Runner` declares a `MarkdownService` field but `NewRunner` is not invoked in production startup code. Tests construct a separate instance in `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go`.
